claim: NodeEligible() dereferences hs.nodeManager without a nil check, a theoretical nil-pointer path (reported then dismissed as unreachable: NewProxyHealthServer has a single production caller where s.NodeManager is guaranteed non-nil).
raw: None found. The one theoretical nil-pointer path (`NodeEligible()` → `hs.nodeManager.Node()` when `nodeManager` is nil) is not reachable in the real flow

claim: s.podCIDRs is now assigned from NodeManager.PodCIDRs() unconditionally instead of only under DetectLocalMode == LocalModeNodeCIDR, so checkBadConfig/checkBadIPConfig now validate PodCIDRs in modes where they were previously skipped, silently changing config-validation behavior.
raw: **`s.podCIDRs` is now populated in every detect-local mode, changing config-validation behavior.** `cmd/kube-proxy/app/server.go:218` sets `s.podCIDRs = s.NodeManager.PodCIDRs()` unconditionally.

claim: OnNodeChange calls exitFunc(1) on any reflect.DeepEqual mismatch of NodeIPs and OnNodeDelete always exits, so order-sensitive or transient node-address churn from kubelet can crash (and potentially crashloop) kube-proxy where previously NodeIP changes were ignored.
raw: kube-proxy now hard-crashes on any NodeIP change and on node deletion... `GetNodeHostIPs` returns an order-sensitive `[]net.IP` and `reflect.DeepEqual` is order-sensitive; transient node-status address churn/reordering from kubelet could theoretically trigger a restart

claim: Startup NodeIP acquisition changed from soft-fail (old getNodeIPs retried ~1 min then returned nil and let kube-proxy proceed) to hard-fail (NewNodeManager polls up to 5 minutes then returns an error preventing kube-proxy from starting), an unannounced behavior change.
raw: Startup NodeIP acquisition changed from soft-fail to hard-fail. Old `getNodeIPs` retried ~6 times (~1 min) and then **returned nil and let kube-proxy proceed**. New `NewNodeManager` polls up to 5 minutes and returns an error

claim: NodeEligible() still takes the exclusive hs.lock although it no longer touches any lock-protected field, needlessly serializing every /healthz request against health updates.
raw: **Superfluous exclusive lock in `NodeEligible()`** (`pkg/proxy/healthcheck/proxy_health.go:176`). It takes `hs.lock.Lock()` but no longer reads or writes any `hs.lock`-protected field

claim: handleChangeNode contains an unreachable cache.DeletedFinalStateUnknown tombstone branch, since it is wired only to the informer's UpdateFunc which never delivers tombstones.
raw: **Dead tombstone branch in `handleChangeNode`** (`pkg/proxy/config/config.go:320-330`). It's wired only to the informer's `UpdateFunc`, which never delivers a `cache.DeletedFinalStateUnknown`

claim: NodeTopologyConfig.listerSynced is assigned in newNodeTopologyConfig but never read, because NodeTopologyConfig has no Run()/WaitForNamedCacheSync.
raw: **`NodeTopologyConfig.listerSynced` is assigned but never read** (`pkg/proxy/config/config.go`, `newNodeTopologyConfig`). Unlike `NodeConfig`, `NodeTopologyConfig` has no `Run()`/`WaitForNamedCacheSync`, so the stored `HasSynced` is dead.

claim: PodCIDRs() and NodeIPs() return references into the informer-owned (shared cache) node object without DeepCopy, inconsistent with Node() which does copy.
raw: **`PodCIDRs()`/`NodeIPs()` hand out references into the informer-owned node object without copying**, while `Node()` correctly `DeepCopy()`s. `PodCIDRs()` returns `n.node.Spec.PodCIDRs` (a live slice header into the cache).

claim: The healthcheck test constructs NodeManager via proxy.NewNodeManager with the real os.Exit and then drives OnNodeChange, so any future tweak touching Status.Addresses would kill the test binary instead of failing the test.
raw: **Test relies on real `os.Exit` staying dormant.** ... It only avoids terminating the test process because `makeNode()` hardcodes a constant IP (`192.168.0.1`) that none of the tweaks change.

claim: The healthcheck test discards the error returned by NewNodeManager (`nodeManager, _ :=`) instead of asserting on it.
raw: The returned error is also discarded (`nodeManager, _ :=`).

claim: The NodeManager type doc comment and the OnNodeChange inline comments are grammatically garbled ("...based on the NodeIPs and PodCIDRs handles node watch events and crashes...").
raw: **Slightly garbled doc grammar** on the `NodeManager` type comment ("...based on the NodeIPs and PodCIDRs handles node watch events and crashes...") and the `OnNodeChange` inline comments. Cosmetic.
